newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sri Lanka tenders to sell end-Nov light naphtha.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka tenders to sell end-Nov light naphtha.

text.p: Sri Lanka's state-owned Ceylon Petroleum Corp (CPC) has issued a tender to sell 125,000 barrels of light naphtha for November 28-29 lifting on a free-on-board (fob) basis from Colombo, a CPC source said on Wednesday.
The tender closes at 1530 hours, Sri Lanka time on November 13 and bids are valid for two days.
In its last tender, CPC sold to Dutch trader Vitol 120,000 barrels of light naphtha at $1.18 per barrel below Singapore spot quotes for October 19-20 lifting, fob Colombo.
